Example national antibacterial prescribing, November 2020 to June 2026

Source: R/data.R
op_example.Rd

Monthly national totals for every BNF chemical substance in section 5.1 (antibacterial drugs) in the crosswalk, in the same layout as the output of op_spending_ab(). The dataset lets the examples and figures run offline.

Usage

op_example

Format

A data frame with columns date, org_type, org_id, org_name, ab, ab_name, atc, code (BNF chemical code(s)), items, quantity, actual_cost.

Source

NHSBSA Open Data Portal, https://opendata.nhsbsa.net/.

Details

Built from the NHS Business Services Authority English Prescribing Dataset (EPD, Open Government Licence v3.0), the dataset OpenPrescribing is derived from, by summing ITEMS, TOTAL_QUANTITY and ACTUAL_COST per chemical substance and month (see data-raw/build_example.R). It was not downloaded from the OpenPrescribing API, so small differences from API values are possible. BNF chemicals that map to the same antimicrobial (for example two doxycycline salts) are summed, as op_spending_ab(aggregate = TRUE) does.

Examples

head(op_example)
#>         date org_type  org_id org_name  ab                     ab_name     atc
